app-testing-usage-limit.title: Load testing spend can be capped with a monthly virtual user hour limit
app-testing-usage-limit.body: This estimate includes load testing. Microsoft lets you cap monthly virtual user hours on a load testing resource, which stops runaway test spend.

citation.source: Manage usage limits on an Azure Load Testing resource
citation.quote: This feature allows you to control the total consumption for a resource by setting monthly Virtual User Hours (VUH) limits.

app-testing-playwright-trial-first-works.title: The Playwright free trial covers only the first workspace
app-testing-playwright-trial-first-works.body: This estimate uses free Playwright trial minutes. Microsoft limits the trial to the first workspace created in the Azure subscription, so later workspaces pay from the first minute.

citation.quote: These limits only apply to the first workspace you create in your Azure subscription.
